# ClipMotion

> ClipMotion (clipmotion.ai) is a web app that turns a product page or a SaaS website link into a ready-to-post video ad: script, voice-over, word-by-word captions, music and MP4 export, in 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9. No filming and no account needed to try it.

## What it does
- E-commerce: builds the ad from the seller's real product photos. Only the plain background is removed; the product is never regenerated, so shape, logo and colours stay exactly as photographed.
- SaaS: combines relevant filmed HD stock footage of the customer's situation, a capture of the real website in a phone frame, real logos of integrated tools joined by animated arrows, and the brand's own logo and colours.
- Voice-over and captions in the page's language, music composed by ClipMotion, licensed royalty-free footage.
- Free preview with a watermark; clean export per video from $0.99, or through a subscription.
